diagnosticExplanation: The only console entry was generated by axe cross-origin stylesheet inspection (XMLHttpRequest of the Google Fonts stylesheet blocked by CSP). Normal buyer navigation reported no runtime errors; a separate browser test confirmed loaded Fraunces and Hanken Grotesk fonts. CSP was not weakened.
